study.research_question: On external web-action steps with K=4 candidate pools, does Jev's score argmax pick the gold action about as often as Astra's pointwise argmax?
study.research_gap: Earlier cohorts used label-only verdicts, three authored tasks and serial arms; calibration, reliability and load-matched comparison were not measured.
study.hypothesis: Top-1 delta CI lower bound above -0.10.

primary_metric.name: x2_score_top1_delta
primary_metric.aggregation: (jev_pointwise top-1 correct - astra_pointwise top-1 correct) / 240 pools; top-1 = argmax of the two-order mean score, ties to the smallest sha256(pool_id + candidate_id); invalid or fallback = wrong

study.decision_rule: supported: CI lower bound above -0.10; not-supported: CI upper bound below -0.10; mixed otherwise. Frozen U0b score_tolerance; no tuning on X2; no latency claim. outcome=diagnostic-only.
study.invalidation_rule: Judgment-output invalid (schema, label, non-finite probability, Choice sum beyond 0.025, verdict not an argmax label, refusal, unexpected stop reason) is a valid attempt with a wrong answer: it stays in accuracy denominators and is excluded from probability metrics. Infrastructure invalid (no response, timeout, missing capture or receipt, harness error, quota exhaustion) is validity=invalid, outcome=unknown. Preregistered panel exception: a transport failure without any response is kept as an unselected invalid attempt and replaced exactly once by a child attempt on the same input; a failed replacement stays selected, makes the primary not measurable and stops the unit; replacements above 2% of planned calls stop the unit. Quota exhaustion, harness errors and route violations (non-subscription Astra, model, effort or provider drift, global Jev) are selected invalid attempts and stop the unit. Pin #2 (0028): non-quota HTTP 429 is rate_limited; wait Retry-After (seconds or HTTP-date, default 30 s, clipped to 0-120 s) then exactly one replacement under the same 2% ceiling. retry_wait_s is excluded from measured latency. quota, billing, usage_limit, usage_not_included and plan_limit codes, HTTP 402 and BillingError are quota_exhausted: stop without replacement.
study.analysis_plan: 05 v2.2 §3 (definitions, cluster bootstrap 2,000, seed from split manifest), §3.5 reliability (U7 only), §3.6 within-pair latency interpretation, §1.5 design-leak rules. selection-freeze sha256: n/a. Workload order per 05 v2.2 §8.1. External validation (05 v2.2 §11): no fitting, tuning or prompt change on external data; no latency claim (latency claims come from U3 only). Correct = the grade-3 recorded next target; primary from score_selection summarize --delta x2=astra_pointwise:jev_pointwise. Cluster bootstrap over website cluster_id (94 clusters; test_website has 10, the minimum for split-level intervals). McNemar discordant counts (b, c) are descriptive only; no p-value (05 v2.2 §11.4). Jev selector receives sum_tolerance=0.025 and score_tolerance from score-tolerance-freeze.json (sha256 8dddb9d1db34f1b0929a85362136568c144b1493f294610b6672e17988087fc5) as explicit arguments; the code defaults are strict 1e-5. Account transition: [account-withheld]/pro; predecessor geode-jev-external-m2w-score-20260927 retained; no old-account model results pooled. P-r1 startup failed before calls (empty adapter registry); P-r2 initializes existing built-ins with EMPTY_POLICY_SOURCES before dispatch. P-r3 uses run-scoped Jev accounting identifiers; predecessor U0a/U0c-i results remain P-r2; P-r2 U1 freeze had no live calls. Host ledger admission and settlement use run plus phase identities; earlier preparation freezes remain intact. bootstrap_manifest_sha256:413fdbcc74d71bd5af807bdac0ff84729ce0e4b8f3deaa7bb8927a1575abc296; Score analysis entry sha256:11e63b5557935be923abb697789b8f4bc97de1463f24e0ab26e8dfe21c0639f5. Source #2 native Score metrics and paired source-cluster percentile bootstrap (2000, 95%) remain unchanged. Signed intervals stay in digest-bound results.json because native v1 rejects negative secondary numerators. X2 split interval metric names are x2_score_top1_delta:registered_split_name; descriptive strata use exact registered metadata values, without p-values or latency claims. Host prospective P5: native STOP/account/lock/cap checks before each Score call, unknown settlement for started calls on native failure; scientific inference conditions unchanged.

environment.reset_strategy: Native Score selection adapters on identical frozen public Mind2Web K=4 pools, independent forward/reverse calls, no root loop or tools. Source #2 native load_pools preserves the original task, candidate text and candidate order; no grades or gold are supplied to selectors. Global execution lock prevents overlap with other U units. Shared subscription account and provider cache effects remain uncontrolled.
